description: This file defines a setup wizard for WhatsApp integration, including configuration status, account linking detection, finalization, and disabling logic.

classes.name: ChannelSetupWizard
classes.description: Interface describing the structure of a setup wizard for a communication channel.

methods.name: resolveConfigured
methods.description: Determines if the WhatsApp account is linked, based on account ID and configuration.

methods.name: resolveStatusLines
methods.description: Generates status line messages regarding WhatsApp linking status.

methods.name: resolveShouldPromptAccountIds
methods.description: Decides whether to prompt for account IDs based on the provided options.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the WhatsApp setup by invoking the finalizeWhatsAppSetup function.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the WhatsApp setup channel, preventing further use.

methods.name: onAccountRecorded
methods.description: Callback invoked when an account ID is recorded, calling the provided handler.

calls: finalizeWhatsAppSetup({ cfg, accountId, forceAllowFrom, prompter, runtime })
